Commentary.Commentary: We are back. The players are out in the middle. Kushal Bhurtel and Aasif Sheikh to open for Nepal. Kaleem Sana to bowl first.
...THE CHASE...

Nepal are known for their bowling attack but today they were below-par for most part of the innings. Sagar Dhakal and Abinash Bohara bowled well in the middle phase as they took three wickets together but apart from that, it was an ordinary performance. It feels Nepal have given 15-20 runs extra here. It's time for their batters now to do the work. It won't be easy as Canada have the momentum but expect Nepal to give a tough fight. Stay tuned for the chase.

That is some batting performance from Canada. They have scored 55 runs in the last three overs. However, we feel Nepal could have done a bit better as they bowled really well after the halfway mark. Canada were looking for a score around 200. Nicholas Kirton was the mainstay while other batters motored around him but Canada slowed down in the middle phase as they kept losing wickets regularly. At that stage, Canada were about to end with a score of 150 but some fine batting from Ravinderpal Singh in the fag end has helped Canada get in a winning position right now.

Nepal, who qualified for the tournament alongside Oman through the Asia Qualifier, are making their second appearance in the T20 World Cup. Led by Rohit Paudel, one of the team's most experienced batters, Nepal will rely on a talented bunch of players to deliver impactful performances. With teams allowed to use all 15 of their players in these warm-up games, they will look to fine-tune their preparations and hit the ground running for the main event. Who are you backing to come out on top in this clash?

Aaron Johnson, Navneet Dhaliwal, and Harsh Thaker will be the key players with the bat, with Johnson having been Canada's top run-getter over the past year. Nicholas Kirton, the young gun, is expected to make a significant impact with his batting prowess. Skipper Saad Zafar will need to lead from the front with the bat as well as through his left-arm spin, while Dillon Heyliger, Kaleem Sana, and Nicholas Jordan will be relied upon to deliver pace bowling duties.

Nepal are placed in Group D alongside the Netherlands, Sri Lanka, South Africa, and Bangladesh, whereas the T20 World Cup debutants, Canada are in Group A with the United States of America, Ireland, India, and Pakistan. The winners of the T20 World Cup Americas Qualifier, Canada will feature on the opening night of the main event against co-hosts the USA, and they will want to make the most of the two warm-up fixtures.

The countdown to the 2024 ICC Men's T20 World Cup has begun as 20 teams from around the globe gather to compete in the biggest tournament in the game's shortest format. The road to the main event begins with a series of official warm-up matches, with Canada taking on Nepal in the opening game at the Grand Prairie Stadium in Dallas. On that note, hello and welcome to the coverage of today's game.
